full_judgment:
6. The learned Advocate for the petitioners argued that the cause of action for the suit having arisen on 29 April 1974 and the suit having been filed on 9 August 1978 the High Court Division was wrong in not holding that the suit was barred by limitation. 

 7. It appears that no issue on limitation was raised in the trial Court. The point was, however, raised before the appellate Court. The learned Judges of the said court overruled the contention observing "as a matter of fact final bill of the plaintiff was made on 3-10-75 and there was continuous transaction between the plaintiff and the defendants and as the defendants made payment upto 3-10-75 as stated earlier so the transaction between the plaintiff and the defendants which continued and if counted from 3-10-75 upto the filing of the suit dated 9-8-78 the plaintiff was within time in filing the suit for realization of his money." The finding is essentially one of fact. This court does not interfere with such a finding of fact, unless it is shown that the finding is based on no evidence or upon a misreading of evidence. No such error has been pointed out to us. We therefore find no substance in the argument.
